changelog:
- Initial release of browsex: a browser-based CLI tool to interact with X/Twitter via OpenClaw.
- Supports common actions: reading timeline, viewing tweets and profiles, posting, liking, retweeting, replying, searching, and following.
- Read-only browsing works without login; write actions require an authenticated X/Twitter account.
- Designed for environments without Homebrew; alternative to the bird CLI.
- Includes detailed usage instructions, troubleshooting tips, and a comparison with bird CLI.
summary: X/Twitter CLI using OpenClaw browser tool. Use when the user wants to interact with X/Twitter: reading timeline, posting tweets, liking, retweeting, replying...
